options.content: Read-only evidence view. The v0.1 gate arm runs under weekly gate discipline (first review 2026-11-16; verdict expected around the week of 2026-11-23). Incidents & interventions are recorded in `docs/interventions.md` (private working copy) and summarized, not tabulated, here. sqlite-vec layers are intentionally out of Grafana's reach.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_trades FROM trades WHERE is_open = 0
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN close_profit > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct FROM trades WHERE is_open = 0
SELECT CAST((julianday('now') - julianday((SELECT MIN(open_date) FROM trades))) / 7 AS INTEGER) AS weeks_live
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_trades FROM trades WHERE is_open = 1

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z', timestamp) AS "time", ROUND(SUM(total_quote), 2) AS portfolio_usdt
FROM wallet_history
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', timestamp)
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z', timestamp) AS "time", ROUND(SUM(total_quote), 2) AS portfolio_usdt
FROM wallet_history
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', timestamp)
ORDER BY "time"

panels.title: Trials — folds & mean test_sharpe per day

targets.queryText:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', created_utc) AS "time",
       COUNT(*) AS folds,
       ROUND(AVG(test_sharpe), 3) AS mean_test_sharpe
FROM trials
WHERE test_sharpe IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', created_utc)
ORDER BY "time"

SELECT created_utc AS time, mode, test_sharpe,
       json_extract(metrics_json, '$.win_rate') AS win_rate,
       json_extract(metrics_json, '$.trades') AS trades,
       json_extract(metrics_json, '$.profit_total') AS profit_total
FROM trials
ORDER BY created_utc

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z', day) AS "time", SUM(items) AS items, SUM(fetches) AS fetches
FROM news_summary
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d', day)
ORDER BY "time"
SELECT day, feed, fetches, items FROM news_summary ORDER BY day DESC, feed
